notes:
Account: Fulcrum Retail - mid-market omnichannel retailer focused on improving post-purchase experience (returns, shipping updates, refunds). Evaluating Redwood Hosted API initially to validate latency and conversational accuracy, then considering Dedicated for predictable capacity during seasonal peaks.

POC scope: 2-week Hosted API POC using 10k anonymized post-purchase transcripts. Goals: (1) confirm p95 end-to-end response latency <= 350ms for streaming chat under baseline concurrency (~50 concurrent agents), (2) validate tool-calling pattern for shipping API (sync & async flows) without blocking user experience, (3) measure cost per ticket and throughput improvements vs current rule-based bot.

Key technical constraints: p95 latency is the hard SLO — ops will escalate if >350ms at peak. Peak season multiplier ~3.5x (BF/CM), expecting bursts up to ~200 concurrent active sessions for post-purchase flows. Must support streaming tokens + tool calls to external shipping/tracking APIs with <100ms additional call overhead where possible.

Security/compliance: require SSO/SAML for admin console, audit log retention policy (90 days minimum), ability to route EU customer data to EU region (data residency), prefer KMS integration for any encryption at rest. SOC2 status important for procurement; Fulcrum requested Redwood security FAQ and evidence (Drive link).

Commercial: interested in Hosted API for fast validation; if POC meets latency targets Redwood to provide Dedicated sizing & pricing for seasonal burst capacity (monthly reserved + burst). Estimated ARR target band submitted by Fulcrum: $50k-$200k.

Quotes / call notes: "can't exceed 350ms p95 or ops will escalate" (Head of Ops). "Tool calling is critical — many cases require dynamic shipping lookups and immediate ETA updates" (Product lead).

Open items: finalize p95 measurement method (end-to-end vs inference-only), Redwood to provide load test results and regression on quality metrics (accuracy on returns classification), procurement needs SOC2 docs and EU residency confirmation.

Next meetings: metrics review with Fulcrum infra + procurement (scheduled tentatively 2026-03-04).
